name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB 武者頑駄無（超鋼Ver.）
name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB Musha Gundam (Super Steel Ver.)

description.ja: ＢＢ戦士ムシャガンダム誕生２５周年記念！
description.en: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of the birth of BB Senshi Musha Gundam!

description.ja: 「ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ 武者頑駄無」が超豪華な超鋼Ver.（スーパーハガネバージョン）となり、プレミアムバンダイに登場！！
description.en: "LEGENDBB Musha Gundam" has become a super luxurious super steel version (super steel version) and is now available on Premium Bandai! !

description.ja: 金属感溢れるメッキの鎧をまとい、新「和シール」が戦国武将の雰囲気たっぷりに演出！
description.en: Wearing plated armor with a metallic feel, the new "Wa Seal" creates a full atmosphere of a Sengoku warlord!

description.ja: ●メッキ加工を多用し、グロスインジェクション、ガンメタ成形など、豪華な質感を成形品でも徹底追及！
description.en: ●We thoroughly pursue the luxurious texture of molded products through extensive use of plating, gloss injection, and gunmetal molding!

description.ja: ●今石画伯デザインの、特殊素材の‘和シール’が付属。吹返、胸板、鎧の各所に貼ってプレミアム感アップ！
description.en: -Comes with a special material 'Japanese Seal' designed by Artist Imaishi. Stick it on the flap, chest plate, and armor for a premium feel!
